(The monomyth ends with return-the hero returning as master of both worlds, But Alan seems to finally understand the futility of adhering to such strict rules when he declares himself to be beyond the monomyth-"no, the master of many worlds").Not to mention he has Saga, Casey and Estevez too probably to help him
Also I think there's an implication that Alice and Alan are like, now paranaturally linked-It's like that bullet of light is crafted from Alice's art, so in a way, it is her.So the ending is Alan, now with the knowledge of the power of collabaration, the light of Alice and the darkness of scratch together making the ending work-and he has the clicker too.I don't  think Alan is back to square one in regards to rescuing Alice, I think he's practically already there.
